source: Corporate Agile Project Workflow Infographic Presentation.pptx
overall_deck_description: Designed as an agile corporate process and workflow presentation, the 10-slide deck utilizes a high-contrast modern infographic style set against a clean, light cool-gray background (#F0F4F9). The sequential color system uses a consistent 4- to 5-step gradient palette running from vivid lime green and emerald teal through deep ocean blue to midnight navy, establishing clear chronological order across every slide. Typography pairs extra-bold sans-serif titles and oversized step numerals (01–05) with legible, neutral sans-serif body copy and subtitles. Key repeating design motifs include white outlined iconography, rounded white content cards with directional ribbon tabs, multi-segment chevron flows, circular loop diagrams, and bent pointer callouts. The deck structure maintains centered top headers with descriptive subheadings on body slides, systematically translating agile phases, sprint cycles, and project benefits into modular visual diagrams.
